description: Regression contract for the accepted shipping Fast Marschner model (Tier 2). The validator passes in --contract=regression mode (the default) when the current run matches the model contract selectors below, the measured total/R/TT/TRT projected-energy ratios match expected within ratio_absolute, and the coarse-vs-fine grid drift is at most grid_drift_max. The strict parity acceptance fields are retained in the validator payload as diagnostic data (see parity_reference) and are intentionally NOT the shipping gate: the accepted shipping state (theta_h Gaussian longitudinal, FM_LONGITUDINAL_MODE 0) measures a ~0.86 total ratio, outside the strict parity band, and this contract pins that state as the passing regression instead.

parity_reference.note: Strict Phase-4 parity acceptance fields, kept here and in the validator payload as diagnostic data. --contract=parity still enforces these bands with a nonzero exit on failure; --contract=regression (default) and --contract=report do not let them decide the exit code.

notes: Expected values measured with the final 512/128 (fine/coarse) deterministic CPU angular integration on Windows Godot: total ratio 0.8625, R 0.5902, TT 0.9156, TRT 1.0700, grid max relative drift 0.000723.
The accepted shipping state intentionally sits outside the strict parity bands; this contract pins it as the passing regression state instead of relaxing the parity bands.
No repository SHA requirement: the model contract selectors/parameters above identify the applicable shader state.
